title: Sharp exponential scale of edit-distance distortion
exact_target: Do absolute $c,C>0$ and $d_{0}$ exist such that, for all $d\geq d_{0}$ and every finite alphabet $\Sigma $ with at least two symbols, the least $L^{1}$ embedding distortion of all words of length at most d with unit-cost insertion, deletion and substitution distance lies between $\exp (c\surd (\log $ d loglog d)) and $\exp (C\surd (\log $ d loglog d))? The constants must be uniform over alphabets and the domain includes the empty word.
